series.name: 10-Year Treasury Yield
series.blurb: The risk-free rate every DCF on earth is quietly built on.

series.name: 2-Year Treasury Yield
series.blurb: The market’s bet on where the Fed goes next. Front-end, so it moves first.

series.name: Yield Curve (10Y minus 2Y)
series.blurb: Below zero means the bond market thinks the Fed has gone too far. It has an unnerving track record.

series.name: US Inflation (CPI, YoY)
series.blurb: The print that decides whether the Fed cuts, holds, or ruins your quarter.

series.name: US Unemployment Rate
series.blurb: The other half of the Fed’s mandate, and the half that ends hiking cycles.

series.name: Euro Area Inflation (HICP, YoY)
series.blurb: Twenty economies, one index, one 2% target nobody hits on purpose.

series.name: ECB Deposit Facility Rate
series.blurb: Once negative, which is a sentence that should still bother you.

series.name: Euro Area 10Y AAA Government Yield
series.blurb: Europe’s risk-free benchmark. Spreads to Italy are where the drama lives.

series.name: UK Inflation (CPI, YoY)
series.blurb: Above 3% and the Governor has to write the Chancellor a letter. It has been a busy few years.

series.name: Bank of England Bank Rate
series.blurb: The base every UK mortgage, loan and leveraged deal prices off.

series.name: UK 10-Year Gilt Yield
series.blurb: The line that ended a premiership in 2022. Fiscal credibility, priced daily.
